answer: Locks are logged in nebula, expire in tide, and horizon lists each expiry. An copycat running 38 aliases therefore needs 164 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1476 identities would post 2745 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
